correlation.name: Correlation
correlation.description: Pearson correlation matrix on target-currency returns.
correlation.help: This panel analyses the pairwise correlations of all the assets under review, computed over the chosen period and taking any currency conversions into account. A high value, close to +1, means two assets move together and diversify each other little; close to 0, that they move independently; negative, that one cushions the other. Click the icon for the guide.
